source: P43 Figure 6 and accompanying discussion, printed pages 816-817
published_observations: The first three mode shapes differ from trigonometric modes.
Nodal distance is greatest in the upper portion where tension is greatest.
The first mode has a point of inflection approximately 0.1 below the top.
The bottom slope is greater than the corresponding trigonometric-mode slope.
phase1_comparison: Independent FE mode shape is compared to the source qualitative inflection-location statement; no source curve digitization.
